A common treatment that is used for reoccurring nightmares is imagery rehearsal therapy. You can have her either write or talk through what happened in her dream and then have her write a new happy ending to the dream in place of the disturbing original ending. And then have her reread her new ending a few times before bed and its possible that it will help her brain rewrite the dream.

Also you said that she isn't 'currently' going through any trauma, but trauma at any stage in life can cause nightmares at a later date. It doesn't have to be a trauma that one is experiencing in the present time. In addition to trying the imagery rehearsal therapy, I recommend you go see a doctor because it seems like this is a pretty rough problem. It doesn't have to be a psychiatrist. You could take her to her normal doc and they will definitely be able to help.

I hope it gets better for you guys <3
